The final review is not clear yet, because of two Medium attribution defects. Neither changes product behaviour, and the review found nothing wrong with the merge, the counters, the bounds, the gap list or the frozen hashes. Child decc7120 is fixing both:

1. **Lost reader origins.** The observer kept only one origin per subscription, so reinstalling a subscription, or having both the qualifier and suffix paths read it, overwrote the earlier origin. The fix keeps the full set of origins across reinstallation, and each wake carries every origin of the subscription it fired.
2. **Mixed charges.** The parser counted a whole charge as test-support whenever any one of its causes was test-support. It will now sort each charge into production-only, test-support-only or mixed, without splitting a charge. The production total is then production-only, with the mixed total beside it.
